label: batch-16
tail:
Batch 16 is authored: 19 A-page items and 3 examples, including a bottom-up recompression routine used by the addition and product procedures. All 22 items have current `ready` records; those records are for independent review, not approval.

Final scoped checks passed: precheck 13/13, proof layout 22 items with 38 steps, strict contracts 13/13, and zero issues in content policy, dependency checks, and render checks. The 22 item levels and dependencies reconcile against the Batch 10+16 graph. Coverage lists 44 harvested results with no errors or warnings. The full [MiS notes](https://www.mis.mpg.de/publications/preprint-repository/lecture_note/2003/issue-21) and [ETH course notes](https://people.math.ethz.ch/~grsam/ADVNCSE/ADVNCSE.pdf) are fetch-verified.

Handoff items remain documented: the Batch 11 page edge is open for `thm-gaussian-rangefinder-expected-spectral-error`, `thm-gaussian-power-rangefinder-expected-error`, and `lem-normalized-complex-scaled-gaussian-product-expectation`; no Batch 16 claim uses them. The plan’s extra spectral-theorem page requirement conflicts with the task and `plan-spec`, so I followed `plan-spec` and recorded the discrepancy. The Bebendorf PDF URL returned five 404s and is recorded as dropped with item-level alternatives; Springer’s listing is subscription-limited ([Springer](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-540-77147-0)).

I also recorded a published defect in [def-frobenius-matrix-norm.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-frobenius-matrix-norm.md:31): its `i<m, j<n` sum omits the final row and column, so a nonzero 1×1 matrix gets value zero. The 25 direct consumers are listed in the batch notes; Batch 16 uses Batch 10’s full-entry Frobenius definition instead.
